intellectual_tradition: Culmination of qi-learning (qi-xue) in the Zhang Zai lineage; founder of the Chuanshan school; summit of ancient Chinese dialectics and philosophy of history; from Hengyang, Hunan
school: 船山学派开创/气学集大成/古代辩证法巅峰
representative_works: 《张子正蒙注》（气一元论宗旨所在）
《读通鉴论》（三十卷历史哲学巨著）
《读四书大全说》（理欲之辨、理势合一）
historical_significance: 王夫之（1619-1692），字而农，号姜斋，湖南衡阳人，晚年隐居衡阳石船山著述，世称船山先生，明末清初三大思想家之一。明亡后举兵抗清，失败后终身不仕，遁迹石船山四十余年，著书百余种、四百余卷。哲学上以张载气学为宗，建立'理者气之理''天下惟器'的气一元论，彻底批判程朱'理先气后'；提出'动静皆动''天地之化日新'的动态宇宙观与'趋时更新'的历史进化论；认识论上'能必副其所'，确立中国哲学史上最明确的符合论真理观；知行观上'知行相资以为用'，批判朱熹知先行后与阳明知行合一；伦理上'人欲之各得即天理之大同'，重建理欲关系；历史观上'理势合一''于其变观其通'，为古代历史哲学之巅峰。谭嗣同称'五百年来学者，真通天人之故者，船山一人而已'。
famous_quote: 天下惟器；理者气之理；静者静动非不动；能必副其所；知行相资以为用；人欲之各得即天理之大同；依人建极
influence: 气一元论为清代实学与近代唯物思潮提供本土源头，谭嗣同、章太炎皆自认船山后学；'知行相资''能必副其所'为近代认识论讨论提供了比宋明理学更精细的框架；'理势合一'的历史观影响了梁启超的新史学与近代历史进化论；'人欲之各得即天理之大同'为近代启蒙思潮（戴震'以理杀人'之批判的先声）提供了内部资源；邓显鹤、曾国藩刊刻《船山遗书》使其思想在晚清大放异彩，成为湖湘学派精神源头之一。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《张子正蒙注·太和篇》：天下惟器而已矣。道者器之道，器者不可谓之道之器也。……无其器则无其道。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In all the world there are only concrete implements. The Way is the Way of implements; one cannot call implements the implements of the Way. Without the implement, there is no Way.
mode_evidence.source: 天下惟器而已矣。道者器之道，器者不可谓之道之器也。……无其器则无其道。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读四书大全说·卷九》：势之所趋，岂非理而能然哉？……理势不可以两截沟分。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Where momentum tends—how could it be thus unless in accordance with principle? Principle and momentum cannot be cut into two separate segments.
mode_evidence.source: 势之所趋，岂非理而能然哉？……理势不可以两截沟分。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《思问录·内篇》：静者静动，非不动也。静即含动，动不舍静。……天地之德不易，而天地之化日新。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Stillness is still-motion, not non-motion. Stillness contains motion; motion does not discard stillness. The virtue of heaven and earth does not change, yet their transformation renews daily.
mode_evidence.source: 静者静动，非不动也。静即含动，动不舍静。……天地之德不易，而天地之化日新。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读通鉴论·卷末》：趋时更新者，顺其势之必然也。……推其所以然之由，辨其不尽然之实，于其变观其通。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: To follow the times and renew is to accord with the necessity of momentum. Trace the causes of why things are so, distinguish where they fall short of necessity, and observe the through-line within change.
mode_evidence.source: 趋时更新者，顺其势之必然也。……推其所以然之由，辨其不尽然之实，于其变观其通。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《尚书引义·卷五》：境之俟用者曰所，用之加乎境而有功者曰能。……乃以俟用者为所，则必实有其体；以用乎俟用而以可有功者曰能，则必实有其用。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The object awaiting use is called suo; there must really be its substance. The function applied to the awaited object with effect is called neng; there must really be its operation.
mode_evidence.source: 境之俟用者曰所，用之加乎境而有功者曰能。……乃以俟用者为所，则必实有其体；以用乎俟用而以可有功者曰能，则必实有其用。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《尚书引义·卷三》：知也者固以行为功；行也者不以知为功者也。行焉可以得知之效也，知焉未可以得行之效也。……知行相资以为用，惟其各有致功而亦各有其效。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Knowledge indeed takes its effect through action; action does not take its effect through knowledge. Acting can yield the test of knowing, but knowing cannot yet yield the test of acting. Knowledge and action draw on each other as resources, each rendering its own service and reaping its own effect.
mode_evidence.source: 知也者固以行为功；行也者不以知为功者也。行焉可以得知之效也，知焉未可以得行之效也。……知行相资以为用，惟其各有致功而亦各

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读四书大全说·卷四》：人欲之各得，即天理之大同；天理之大同，无人欲之或异。……终不离人而别有天，终不离欲而别有理也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The due satisfaction of each person's desires is precisely the great commonality of heavenly principle; this great commonality admits no exceptional desires. Never apart from the human is there a heaven, never apart from desire a principle.
mode_evidence.source: 人欲之各得，即天理之大同；天理之大同，无人欲之或异。……终不离人而别有天，终不离欲而别有理也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《读通鉴论·卷十四》：夷狄之走向文明，即殊其类而亦进于人。……彼为戎狄之行者，不可以为人也。则虽殊其类，而因其可进，进之可也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: When the Yi-Di move toward civilization, though their kind differs they too advance toward the human. Those who act as barbarians cannot be counted human. Though their kind differs, since they can advance, let them advance.
mode_evidence.source: 夷狄之走向文明，即殊其类而亦进于人。……彼为戎狄之行者，不可以为人也。则虽殊其类，而因其可进，进之可也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《尚书引义·卷一》：名非天造，必从其实。……知实而不知名，弗求名则无以通其不知者于已知名者；知名而不知实，则其知名也适足以凿其实。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Names are not made by heaven; they must follow the actual. Know the actual without the name, and without seeking the name you cannot connect the unknown to the known; know the name without the actual, and your knowledge of the name merely carves away the actual.
mode_evidence.source: 名非天造，必从其实。……知实而不知名，弗求名则无以通其不知者于已知名者；知名而不知实，则其知名也适足以凿其实。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《周易外传·卷二》：自然者天地，主持者人。人者，天地之心也。……即人而言天之，则天即在于人之所谓天者。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The spontaneous belongs to heaven and earth; the presiding belongs to humanity. The human is the heart of heaven and earth. Speak of heaven through the human, and heaven is precisely the heaven named within the human.
mode_evidence.source: 自然者天地，主持者人。人者，天地之心也。……即人而言天之，则天即在于人之所谓天者。

cross_references.description_zh: 黄宗羲重'制度设计'与'学术史'（学校的议政功能、学案体的知识整理），王夫之重'形而上建构'与'历史哲学'（气一元论、理势合一）；黄是制度工程师，王是体系哲学家。
cross_references.description_en: Huang Zongxi stressed institutional design and intellectual history (deliberative schools, the juan'an genre), while Wang Fuzhi built metaphysics and philosophy of history (monism of qi, unity of principle and momentum). Huang was the institutional engineer; Wang the systematic philosopher.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之重'历史循环论'与'气一元论'的形而上建构，顾炎武重'实证考据'与'实地调研'的现实指向；王偏哲学思辨，顾偏方法工程与知识工程。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Fuzhi stressed the metaphysical construction of historical cycles and the monism of qi, while Gu Yanwu pursued evidential scholarship and field research. Wang inclined to philosophical speculation; Gu to method engineering and knowledge engineering.

modern_value_zh: 理者气之理——追问物质承担者的思维：谈规律先确认载体，谈理念先验证实现
理势合一——趋势与规律统一分析：价值判断建立在趋势判断之上，反对悬空道德
能必副其所——客观符合论：区分主体体验与对象事实，以实有为知识标准
知行相资——知行循环互馈：交付物是唯一验收，拒绝用'想清楚了'替代'做出来'
人欲之各得即天理之大同——制度的人性基准：道德批判先问是否压制基本人性
modern_value_en: Principle as the principle of qi: before discussing any law, confirm its material bearer; before any ideal, verify its implementation
Unity of principle and momentum: ground value judgment in trend judgment; refuse suspended moralizing
The faculty must match the object: separate subjective experience from object fact; take real existence as the standard of knowledge
Knowledge and action as mutual resources: the deliverable is the sole acceptance test; never substitute 'thought through' for 'carried out'
Due satisfaction of desires as heavenly principle: institutions must be tested against basic humanity before moralizing
unique_thing: Wang Fuzhi's core achievement was 'the completion of ancient Chinese dialectics and the pivot of value back to the human.' He reversed the priority of concept over existence ('without the implement there is no Way'), fused the law of history with its real momentum ('principle and momentum cannot be cut apart'), and declared the clearest correspondence theory of truth in Chinese philosophy ('the faculty must match the object'). He did not merely annotate the classics: writing in hiding for forty years after his kingdom fell, he turned the fall of the Ming into a laboratory of historical philosophy, reading two millennia of the Zizhi Tongjian for the through-line within change. His reconstruction—desire as the seat of principle, the human as the pivot of the cosmos—proved that sound thought does not flee the world's mess: it is distilled from it. Five centuries of scholars, Tan Sitong said, produced only one who truly joined heaven and man.
